name: Relax at Playa Brava
description: Spend the afternoon by the ocean at one of Punta del Este’s most well-known beaches.

name: Visit La Mano Sculpture
description: Visit the famous hand sculpture rising from the sand, one of the city’s most recognizable landmarks.

name: Visit El Faro
description: Head to El Faro for a classic Punta del Este stop with coastal views, sea breeze, and one of the area’s most recognizable landmarks nearby.

name: Ride Up to Sugarloaf Mountain
description: Take in sweeping views of Rio’s beaches, mountains, and skyline from one of the city’s most famous viewpoints.

name: Spend the Day at Ipanema Beach
description: Relax on one of Rio’s most iconic beaches and enjoy the energy of the city right by the water.

name: Visit Christ the Redeemer
description: Head up the mountain to see one of the most famous landmarks in the world and take in the panoramic city views.

name: Visit El Planetario
description: Stop by El Planetario, one of Buenos Aires’s most recognizable landmarks, set beside the parks and walking paths of Palermo. Its futuristic design and surrounding green space make it a fun break from the busier parts of the city.

name: Tour Teatro Colón
description: Step inside one of the most beautiful opera houses in the world and admire the grand interiors, rich history, and elegant design that make it so iconic.

name: Dinner in Palermo
description: Head to Palermo for a long dinner surrounded by stylish restaurants, candlelit patios, and the neighborhood’s laid-back nightlife energy.
